title: A local ring is geometrically unibranch exactly when its strict henselization has a unique minimal prime
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: statement 是几何单枝与严格 Hensel 化唯一极小素理想的等价（作者在 statement 的 reference 环境里注明出自 Etale coverings 的 Lemma 2.2 与 EGA IV 18.8.15）。虽然开篇说「这一条也可由 lemma-geometric-branches 推出」，但作者随即给出并写完了直接证明，而且这段直接证明结构完整：正向用反证——把 A' 的「不局部」或「剩余域扩张非纯不可分」的缺陷用有限多个元素装进一个有限子代数 B，张量到严格 Hensel 化后既有至少两个极大理想（若不然 B⊗κ^sh 会分拆），又被夹在整环里，矛盾；反向沿 étale 代数的局部化把「唯一极小素理想」下推，用到 A′⊗B 是局部正规整环。承重演算全在 span 内；9 处引用里 2 处同章、7 处跨章，全部作导航桩；statement 里的两处 \cite 落在 reference 环境（该源定义为 comment 型）内，内容被丢弃、不参与编译，因此无需书目。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-geometrically-unibranch (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 31452-31464

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the direct proof in both directions: the integral closure argument that a second maximal ideal or a non purely inseparable residue field would split the strict henselization, and the descent of uniqueness of the minimal prime along localizations of etale algebras (source lines 31466-31550)
